Card Q&A.a: No. This card’s effect can only trash purple Digimon cards.
Card Q&A.q: If I reveal a non-purple Digimon card with this card’s [On Play] effect, can I trash it?

Effect: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 Tamer card among them to your hand, and trash 1 purple Digimon card among them. Place the remaining cards at the bottom of your deck in any order.
